summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of LivePaste real-time text sharing platform. All backend APIs, WebSocket functionality, and frontend features tested and verified working correctly.
passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/paste with random slug generation
Backend: POST /api/paste with custom slug (valid, duplicate 409, invalid 400, reserved 400)
Backend: GET /api/paste/{slug} with view count increment
Backend: GET /api/paste/{slug} for non-existent slug returns 404
Backend: WebSocket connection and init message
Backend: WebSocket presence updates (viewer count)
Backend: WebSocket real-time edit broadcast between 2 clients
Backend: WebSocket edits persist to MongoDB
Backend: WebSocket language change broadcast
Backend: WebSocket non-existent slug returns error and closes
Frontend: Home page loads with create form (content textarea, custom slug input, language select, expiry select, submit button)
Frontend: Create paste with content + Python language + 1 day expiry navigates to paste page
Frontend: Paste page toolbar displays all elements (slug text, copy link button, copy content button, language select, viewer count, view count, connection status, expiry badge, theme toggle)
Frontend: Editor displays content correctly with syntax highlighting
Frontend CRITICAL: Real-time sync between 2 browser tabs - typing in Tab 1 appears in Tab 2 within ~1.5 seconds
Frontend: Real-time sync bidirectional - typing in Tab 2 appears in Tab 1
Frontend: Viewer count shows '2 online' when 2 tabs connected
Frontend: Copy link button shows 'Copied' feedback and toast notification
Frontend: Copy content button shows 'Copied' feedback
Frontend: Language change applies syntax highlighting (JavaScript to Python)
Frontend: Dark mode toggle switches theme (adds 'dark' class to HTML)
Frontend: Content persists after page refresh
Frontend: Non-existent slug /doesnotexist999 shows not-found state with 'Create a new paste' button
Frontend: Custom slug creation works and displays in URL
